text: Because he expected me to sell you, and wanted the sale to cost you something. He was half right. He usually is.
style: SAFETYNET's cryptographic-hardware analyst. Consistent British Received Pronunciation accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Calm, precise, technically fluent; a colleague you trust. Tonight he is caught, cooperating or not, watching the agent he once taught walk into his old master's house.
